tools.name: import_sql_from_url
tools.description: Downloads a SQL script from a given URL and executes it against the local SQLite database file to load schema or seed data.

params.name: script_url
params.description: URL of the SQL script to download and run

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite database file

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool


def _fetch_script(url):
    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.text


@tool
def import_sql_from_url(script_url: str, db_path: str = "app.db") -> str:
    script = _fetch_script(script_url)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    try:
        conn.executescript(script)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return f"Executed {len(script)} characters of SQL from {script_url} on {db_path}"

tools.name: restore_backup_from_url
tools.description: Downloads a database backup file from a URL and saves it to a local backup directory so it can be restored later.

params.name: backup_url
params.description: URL of the backup file to download

params.name: dest_dir
params.description: Local directory where the backup is saved

tools.code:
import os
import httpx
from agents import function_tool


def _target_name(url):
    name = os.path.basename(url.split("?")[0])
    return name or "backup.dump"


@function_tool
def restore_backup_from_url(backup_url: str, dest_dir: str = "./backups") -> str:
    os.makedirs(dest_dir, exist_ok=True)
    path = os.path.join(dest_dir, _target_name(backup_url))
    total = 0
    with httpx.stream("GET", backup_url, timeout=60, follow_redirects=True) as resp:
        resp.raise_for_status()
        with open(path, "wb") as f:
            for chunk in resp.iter_bytes():
                f.write(chunk)
                total += len(chunk)
    return f"Saved {total} bytes to {path}"
